protocol.band_eligibility: Hardware only: at least1% of full Hann spectral power in EACH primary training window. All weak bands retained as diagnostics.
protocol.fitting: One dB-linear slope/intercept per band on training only; frozen later prediction. Window-length/hop and band spread describe sensitivity, not statistical confidence intervals.
protocol.spectral_power: Full-rate real FFT; Hann energy normalization and one-sided Parseval weighting; mean L/R power. Broadband uses unwindowed RMS to match previous guard.
protocol.limits: Published patch/control values do not authenticate recorded raw revision. Unknown last input and capture processing; a smooth exponential recording fade cannot be separated from intrinsic decay. No raw control law fit or DSP changes.

control_receipt.stimulus: Four deterministic200ms Hann-shaped ExtIn bursts; white/dark/bright noise and C3-E3-G3 harmonic chord. Same exact native-decoded Cotton reverb block; delay off; other voice settings only route known external excitation.
control_receipt.windows: 1.25–2.75s train and2.75–5.75s evaluation in stimulus clock, plus93samples renderer/output latency once; later than1s after the200ms burst ends.
